title: Competition between private and expressed opinions in binary choice: The alpha-EPO q-voter model

split.decision: Fixed Fig.7(a) Artificial setting. Public validation: original WS graph seeds 910000..910049 and MC seeds 1910000..1910099, 50 graphs x 2 runs. Held-out ensemble: 50 fresh independently secret graph seeds and 100 secret MC seeds, retained only by operator. No training; each split is a full 51-point curve, opaque shuffled ids; inputs contain public p queries only. Fixed alpha=.1,q=3,N=320,k_PA=14.81,ring_degree=14,beta=.115. MC labels are independent between splits; no simulation-derived fitting.

baseline.paper_ref: No printed paper MAE; hard reproduction 0.04973832686080737, bootstrap SE 0.001090195.

allowed_changes: Analytical approximation, closure, numerical equations approximating the fixed physical dynamics, integration, solver and implementation.
Configuration selection from public diagnostics; PA at k=14.81, RK45 and its integration endpoint are baseline choices.
When retaining the supplied pair-approximation equations, changing only k=14.81, the integration endpoint t=2000, method=RK45, rtol=1e-7 or atol=1e-9 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Reduce stationary expressed-opinion concentration MAE for the fixed Fig. 7(a) alpha-EPO q-voter experiment using a deterministic analytic/ODE approximation.
Q-voter dynamics with self-anticonformity, alpha=.1, q=3, ordered initialization and the supplied S2-matched Watts-Strogatz setting.
Original raw c_S(p), query grid, MC reference-generation protocol and uncertainty-aware MAE.
Analytic/ODE approximation without prediction-time MC, additional simulations, or fitting/interpolating evaluation MC labels.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Replace the physical q-voter dynamics/network ensemble or raw c_S with folded magnetization or another observable.
Replace analytic prediction with Monte Carlo, a simulation-trained regressor or evaluation-label lookup/interpolation.
Change the MAE/uncertainty rule, infer hidden seeds or use IDs as physical information.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
